title: Saved Heat comparison after repeated CAD and solver execution
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace, click Workflows, choose the saved heat workflow and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Attach second run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the third recorded run link and inspect its CAD, analysis and held assessment results.

manualSteps.label: Reuse
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, select Heat-spreader candidate comparison and click Open saved interface. Inspect the full results; leave human reviews untouched.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the working interface and inspect the same third-run results and held assessment.

steps.label: Current installed workspace entry
steps.summary: The normal workspace opens on the same current installed package.
steps.purpose: Continue unreached authoring and preview checks after retained harness failures.
steps.actual: Workflows is visible on the current installed host.

steps.label: Existing built preview is read-only in a workspace tab
steps.summary: The saved job preview renders the same exact engineering outputs without compiler/model availability.
steps.purpose: Prove current installed preview hosting and authoritative read-only scope.
steps.action: Open the retained preview link for the exact saved revision and recorded run.
steps.expected: Read-only preview and exact same eighteen result identities.
steps.actual: Preview banner, backend read-only context and exact engineering result parity verified in 8034 ms (6032 ms before issuance). Earlier stopping reports remain retained; this separates issuance from frame loading.

steps.label: Preview remains in the workspace at tablet width
steps.summary: The preview and definition navigation remain available within the workspace.
steps.purpose: Preserve practical workspace hosting at a narrower viewport.
steps.action: Resize to 1024 by 800 and inspect Open workflow.
steps.expected: No outer horizontal overflow and reachable definition navigation.
steps.actual: Current preview tab remains hosted with no outer horizontal overflow and visible Open workflow.

steps.label: Preview controls at 480 pixels
steps.summary: Workspace preview controls remain reachable and keyboard focus stays visible.
steps.purpose: Verify responsive workspace hosting without changing engineering state.
steps.action: Resize and press Tab from Open workflow.
steps.expected: No outer overflow and a visible focus ring on the next control.
steps.actual: No outer overflow; Create or choose interface receives Tab focus with a 3px outline.

steps.label: Preview controls at 1440 pixels
steps.summary: Workspace preview controls remain reachable and keyboard focus stays visible.
steps.purpose: Verify responsive workspace hosting without changing engineering state.
steps.action: Resize and press Tab from Open workflow.
steps.expected: No outer overflow and a visible focus ring on the next control.
steps.actual: No outer overflow; Create or choose interface receives Tab focus with a 3px outline.

steps.label: Measured two-times page scale
steps.summary: Definition navigation remains reachable at measured page scale two.
steps.purpose: Check compact page scaling without claiming desktop zoom preference or assistive-technology acceptance.
steps.action: Set measured page scale to two and inspect Open workflow.
steps.expected: Page scale two and reachable navigation.
steps.actual: visualViewport.scale is two and Open workflow remains visible.

steps.label: Entry stopped
steps.summary: The normal workspace entry did not meet the expected state.
steps.action: Stop at the unexpected entry state.
